authority_statement: This file proposes links only. It does not append ledger events, mutate cards, mark controls operational, or advance any state.

disposition_semantics.existing_gap_candidate: A conservative source-derived relationship to one or more exact existing stable card IDs; it is not proof that the card is current or that the control was walked.
disposition_semantics.source_trace_only_not_walked: The control exists in inventory v2 with source references, but no sufficiently exact card link and no installed-host walk evidence is asserted here.
disposition_semantics.orphan_contract_candidate: Reserved for a typed control whose required counterpart is missing. Zero typed controls receive it because known orphan contracts are missing the control side itself and are reported at card level.

incorrect_or_cross_surface_ownership.reason: Catalog edit/reopen starts on Agents and crosses into Agent Studio.
The chain crosses catalog open, workflow draft submit, and lifecycle reopen.
The named open/operate controls are owned by Studio Lifecycle while affected fields are Agent Studio data.
validate/admit are rendered Studio Lifecycle controls.
inspect punch card is rendered in Diagnostics.
Ledger projection defect is backend-owned; the visible count is Diagnostics-owned.
Coverage inspection is rendered in Diagnostics and sourced from ledger projection.
Card query controls are rendered in Diagnostics; truncation/counting is backend-owned.
The visible invalid-ledger failure path is Diagnostics-owned.
Card/source opening is rendered in Diagnostics; omitted fields originate in the API.
The three counted openSettings controls are rendered on Settings.
One card combines host acknowledgement contracts used by seven surfaces and should be split by route/control.

orphan_contract_cards_without_typed_cont.reason: graphLoadAll handler contract has no rendered typed control in inventory v2
UI-only actions were recorded against nonexistent host message types
previewGovernedAction was removed and is absent from the current typed inventory/controller
selectProvider is admitted inbound but no visible sidebar control emits it

new_findings.finding: The 132-card snapshot has 0 cards with populated linked_controls; no typed control/card linkage may be inherited without reconciliation.
67 historical cards use a placeholder control_action and are too broad to assign safely without splitting or exact control reconciliation.
12 cards have cross-surface or incorrect visible-control ownership and require ownership correction or root-cause/display splitting.
4 existing cards describe orphan contracts whose missing side has no typed control ID to receive a control assignment.
0 ledger cards have no canonical_surface and cannot be safely attributed to a rendered surface without separate backend ownership metadata.
704 of 827 typed controls remain source-traced but not walked in an installed host; this proposal intentionally makes no operational or completion claim for them.

The current 827-control inventory v2 adds explicit menu/form/editor containers and supersedes the earlier 765-control typed report for assignment counting; prior surface-level examined/progress state cannot be inherited as control-level operational evidence.
